ModMetaData.name: Foundations - Medieval - Material / Progression: Production Patch
ModMetaData.author: Idol Of Magic
ModMetaData.description:
Compatibility patch for Fortifications - Medieval - Material and Progression: Production.
Switches Stonecrushing from Medieval to Neolithic so that Stonecutting is no longer blocked.
It can be used on its own with just FM - Material if you're into that sort of thing!?
